sources.title: [26.19] "Your soul is blooming!" A Lillia Guide🌼

passive.name: Dream-Laden Bough
passive.text: Hitting a champion or monster with a skill will deal additional max Health damage over time.

spells.name: Blooming Blows
spells.text: Passively, Lillia gains stacking Move Speed when hitting enemies with spells. She can activate this to deal magic damage to nearby enemies, dealing extra true damage on the edge.

spells.name: Watch Out! Eep!
spells.text: Lillia deals damage in a nearby area, dealing heavy damage in the center.

spells.name: Swirlseed
spells.text: Lillia hurls a seed that damages and slows those it lands on. If it doesn't hit anything, it will continue rolling until it hits a wall or target.

spells.name: Lilting Lullaby
spells.text: Lillia causes all enemies with Dream Dust on them to become Drowsy before falling asleep. Those enemies will take extra damage on being forcibly woken up.

damage.value: Lillia deals sustained max-Health damage over time, while W deals heavy damage in its center and Q deals extra true damage at its edge.

axis.value: Lillia can poke with E’s 700-range damaging slow before moving into Q’s 450-range area.

winCondition.value: Lillia wins by speeding through the map and putting enemies to sleep.

spikes.why: Lillia can use Blooming Blows more often than at its 6-second cooldown.

mistakes.value: Lillia misses Q’s extra true damage when she fails to hit with its edge.
